goal: Users can read accurate scoped financial outcomes, choose a date range and inspect field explanations in the approved modern Prop layout without changing their ledger.
non_goals: No remote operations or live business testing
No changes to classic markup, lower overview panels, catalog or account forms
No framework migration or business-code commit/push
expected_evidence: Focused failing tests before implementation and passing tests afterward
Full npm test and bundle/syntax output
Offline real-source browser checks with synthetic data
unsafe_assumptions: The prototype contains fixture-only date bounds and per-day iteration; neither belongs in production
Region repaint may replace focused triggers
An empty range is not a failed load; negative investment must not be clamped to zero
stop_condition: Stop if entry is not approved, edits exceed scope, accounting meaning changes, or validation would require live data.
